name: Yumina
source: Anyway, this little sister just loves her older brother. She always wants to be with him, and wants to help him with anything and everything. Naturally it's her duty as his little sister to serve as a model for his photography. In fact, she wants him to take pictures of her. She also wants to strongly show her feminine appeal to her older brother who has always thought of her as a child. She loves cooking. She still has a lot to learn when it comes to tennis.
